activity.notes: Mithridates II was one of the greatest Arsacid rulers. Encyclopaedia Iranica places his accession around 124/123 BCE and his death around 88/87 BCE; exact chronology varies by reconstruction. During his reign Parthia expanded its influence in Mesopotamia and Armenia, opened diplomatic contact with Han China, and made early formal contact with Rome. ATLAS therefore records c.124–c.88 BCE rather than forcing one disputed terminal year.
